description: Window / table-calc degradation (beads-sigma-woaa). A dataset-level CreateColumnsOperation (runningSum) and an analysis-level CalculatedField (percentOfTotal) both use window functions, which silently error in Sigma DM calc columns. Verifies they degrade to a valid 'Null' formula (original expr preserved in description) so the WHOLE model POSTs cleanly with zero error columns — not a comment-only formula that fails all-or-nothing.
